content: Use GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 in Ima Studio Canvas to turn a single product image into multiple campaign assets (product shots, digital talent, storyboards, video ads, posters).
tips: Use GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 in Ima Studio Canvas to turn a single product image into multiple campaign assets (product shots, digital talent, storyboards, video ads, posters).

es.content: Usa GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 en Ima Studio Canvas para convertir una sola imagen de producto en múltiples assets de campaña (fotografías de producto, talento digital, storyboards, anuncios de video, pósters).

fr.content: Utilisez GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 dans Ima Studio Canvas pour transformer une seule image de produit en plusieurs assets de campagne (photos de produit, talents numériques, storyboards, publicités vidéo, affiches).

ja.content: Ima Studio Canvas で GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 を使い、1 枚の製品画像を複数のキャンペーン素材（商品ショット、デジタルタレント、ストーリーボード、動画広告、ポスター）に変換します。

ko.content: Ima Studio Canvas에서 GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0을 사용해 단일 제품 이미지를 여러 캠페인 에셋(제품 샷, 디지털 탤런트, 스토리보드, 영상 광고, 포스터)으로 변환하세요.

pt.content: Use GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 no Ima Studio Canvas para transformar uma única imagem de produto em múltiplos assets de campanha (fotos de produto, talentos digitais, storyboards, anúncios em vídeo, pôsteres).

zh.content: 在 Ima Studio Canvas 中使用 GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0，将一张产品图转化为多种营销素材（产品拍摄图、数字人、分镜脚本、视频广告、海报）。
